info.title: Aurora API
info.description: Programmatic access for ad account operations. Authenticate using your API key in the X-API-Key header.

business_manager_value.description: Numeric ID or unique identifier of the Business Manager to share with.

business_manager_email_value.description: Admin email of the Business Manager. Required for TikTok accounts.

confirmation.description: Confirmation that terms have been reviewed. Required when set to true.

amount_to_clear.description: Amount to withdraw from the account in the account currency (not in cents). Min: 1.00, up to 2 decimal places. Omit to request clearing all available funds.

additional_fee.description: Additional fee applied to the clearing request in the account currency (not in cents). Min: 0.00, up to 2 decimal places. Optional.

already_fully_cleared_acknowledged.description: Set to true to confirm funds are still on an account that was already fully cleared with nothing added since. Without it such a request is rejected with CLEAR_FUNDS_ALREADY_FULLY_CLEARED.

amount.description: Top-up amount in the account currency (not in cents). Min: 1.00, Max: 1,000,000.00, up to 2 decimal places. Example: 500.00 means $500.

add_fee.description: Fee handling. In BOTH modes the fee is `amount × fee_rate` (rate × the amount you typed). `false` (default): the fee is deducted — `amount` is charged to the company balance and `amount − fee` is credited to the ad account. `true`: the fee is added on top — `amount + fee` is charged to the company balance and `amount` is credited in full. Fee % is always against the amount you typed. Example at 4%: 800.00 → false: charged 800.00, fee 32.00, credited 768.00; true: charged 832.00, fee 32.00, credited 800.00.

supported_currencies.description: List of supported currencies for this platform

lifetime_gross_top_ups.description: Total charged to the wallet by successful top-ups, in the account currency — fees included in BOTH fee modes (deducted: the fee is carved out of it; added on top: the fee is inside it). Excludes reverted/rejected/pending requests. Never derive an average fee rate as fees_total / lifetime_gross_top_ups — that understates a fee added on top (3.85% for 4%); the fee base is each top-up's requested_amount_cents.

clearable_amount.description: Amount still clearable/refundable (landed top-ups minus approved clear-funds, fees excluded), in the account currency. Never negative.

approved_clear_funds.description: Lifetime approved clear-funds total, in the account currency.

reverted_top_ups.description: Gross amount of reverted top-ups (informational; excluded from totals), in the account currency.

fees_total.description: Lifetime sum of Aurora top-up fees on successful top-ups, in the account currency. Fee % = fee ÷ the amount you typed (requested_amount_cents on each top-up), never fees_total ÷ lifetime_gross_top_ups.

last_top_up_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent top-up, or null.

hidden.description: Whether the account is hidden from the dashboard.

properties.description: Platform-specific account properties (structure varies by type).

balance.description: Account balance. Included on list endpoints.

top_ups_summary.description: Lifetime top-ups aggregate. Included on detail endpoints.

bm_share_from_application.description: Whether this request originated from an application.

account_id.description: UUID of the ad account to share.

business_manager_value.description: Business Manager ID to share the account with.

business_manager_email_value.description: Business Manager email. Required for TikTok accounts, optional for other platforms.

bulk_request_id.description: Shared bulk request ID (UUID) that groups all requests in this batch.

requests.description: Array of created BM share requests.

amount_to_clear_cents.description: Amount to clear in account currency cents.

additional_fee_cents.description: Additional fee in account currency cents.

amount_cents.description: Raw stored amount in cents. Interpret with `amount_is_net`: when true it is the net funds cleared; otherwise (legacy) it is the gross total returned. Prefer the resolved `funds_cleared_cents` / `total_returned_cents` fields.

amount_is_net.description: Whether `amount_cents` is the net funds cleared (true) or a legacy gross total (false).

funds_cleared_cents.description: Net ad-account funds cleared, in cents (resolved).

total_returned_cents.description: Total returned to the company wallet in cents: funds cleared + reimbursed fee (resolved).

replayed.description: true when the Idempotency-Key matched an earlier request: the figures below are that prior request and nothing was charged again.

fee_calculation_mode.description: Fee handling the figures were computed with. The fee is ALWAYS fee_percentage × requested_amount_cents (rate × the amount you sent). DEDUCT_FEE_FROM_REQUESTED_AMOUNT (add_fee=false): the fee is deducted — requested_amount_cents is charged, requested_amount_cents − fee_cents is credited. ADD_FEE_ON_TOP_OF_REQUESTED_AMOUNT (add_fee=true): the fee is added on top — requested_amount_cents + fee_cents is charged, requested_amount_cents is credited in full. UNKNOWN only on an idempotent replay of a legacy request whose basis was never recorded (then fee_percentage and requested_amount_cents are null).

fee_percentage.description: Aurora fee rate as a FRACTION (0.04 = 4%). Fee % = fee_cents / requested_amount_cents in both modes — never fee_cents ÷ the wallet charge (3.85% for a 4% fee added on top).

requested_amount_cents.description: The amount you sent, in cents = the fee base (charged_to_wallet_cents when deducted, credited_to_account_cents when added on top).

charged_to_wallet_cents.description: Total debited from the company balance (wallet), fee included in both modes.

fee_cents.description: Aurora fee in cents = fee_percentage × requested_amount_cents.

credited_to_account_cents.description: What lands in the ad account, in cents = charged_to_wallet_cents − fee_cents.
